purpose: Sequenced research backlog for the 40→20→10→5 reconstruction hypothesis. Registration is not evidence of completion.

policy.status_rules: A task is complete only when its declared evidence artifact exists and passes structural, cutoff/leakage, baseline, split and multiple-testing validation. A valid null result completes an analytical task; promotion remains incomplete until the registered gate minimum (currently 200 complete prospective paired targets; 200 preferred) and registered criteria are met. Human review/integration is required before Q80 or Q81 is marked COMPLETE; passing automated validators alone leaves each VALIDATED_PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW.
policy.strategy_catalog_policy: Catalog occasional, intermittent, conditional, complementary, antagonistic, retrospective and null strategies; keep ex-ante and retrospective evidence separate. Formula-universe claims must name the finite grammar explored.
policy.archive_freshness: As of 2026-10-28, main archive contains draws through 2026-10-27, while the research branch's Q80/Q81/Q82 reports and archive are currently cut off at 2026-10-25. Reconcile and rerun before calling these reports current; immutable freezes remain append-only.
